newsitem.title: USA: Hilite unit being reviewed by Ford.
newsitem.headline: Hilite unit being reviewed by Ford.

text.p: Hilite Industries Inc said Tuesday that its Speciality Components and Assemblies Division will not be considered for new business by Ford Motor Co until Ford completes a review of the division's status as a "Ford-accredited supplier."
The division, acquired by Hilite in July 1995, has been an accredited Ford supplier since 1990, Hilite said.
The company did not specify what prompted Ford's review.
There is no indication the review will hurt the division's business, which represented $14.4 million of Hilite's fiscal 1996 net sales of $72.6 million, Hilite said.

"We are aggressively pursuing actions and plans to conclude this review favorably. Hilite's other divisions' business from Ford Motor Co is unaffected by this development," said Hilite Chief Executive Daniel Brady.
